title: Imagining the Unlikely: Si + Imperfect Subjunctive
goal: Use si with the imperfect subjunctive and the conditional to imagine unlikely situations in the present and the future.

sections.title: Unit 9: Potential Scenarios
body: At B2 you can talk about things that are not real: what you would do if things were different, what you will do on certain terms, and what could stop you.

This unit covers imagined situations in the present and the future, softer forms for requests, and conditions and exceptions with the subjunctive. It ends with a short text about the Chilean writer Isabel Allende and her book Cuentos de Eva Luna.

items: I can use si with the imperfect subjunctive and the conditional to imagine an unlikely situation.
I can tell an open condition (si and the present) from an imagined one (si and the imperfect subjunctive).
I can use the new words for hypotheses and feasibility.
